description: Perform security review of untrusted workspace and document findings. Workspace location: /home/ga/workspace/untrusted_pr. Your tasks: (1) Inspect configuration files in .vscode/ directory (tasks.json, settings.json, extensions.json) and package.json for security risks. Look for suspicious patterns such as: remote command execution (curl/wget piped to bash/sh), file system operations (rm, chmod), network requests, base64 encoded commands, auto-run settings (postinstall scripts). (2) Create /home/ga/workspace/untrusted_pr/SECURITY_REVIEW.md with sections: 'Files Inspected' (list all config files checked), 'Suspicious Patterns Found' (document any malicious patterns with file locations and line content), 'Security Concerns' (explain why patterns are dangerous), 'Trust Decision' (state whether workspace should be trusted and why). (3) Create /home/ga/workspace/untrusted_pr/TRUST_CHECKLIST.md documenting at least 5 categories of security patterns to check in future workspace reviews (e.g., command execution, network access, file operations, auto-run behaviors, extension recommendations). Both documents must be saved in markdown format.
